seeded_defects.title: Objects whose system status carries DLFL or INAC
seeded_defects.expected: C2 excludes exactly these 40 rows (8 functional locations and 32 equipment).

seeded_defects.title: Functional locations with a blank superior FL
seeded_defects.expected: C3 derives the parent of all 25 from the FL code. For 22 the parent exists in File A. For 3 the parent TZ1-UTL-S11 is absent, so one placeholder FL flagged DERIVED is created with a warning. The two installation roots also have a blank superior and are not part of this count.

seeded_defects.title: Equipment installed at a functional location that is not in File A
seeded_defects.expected: D2 raises one Error issue per row. Commit is blocked until resolved.

seeded_defects.title: Keys that appear twice in their file
seeded_defects.expected: D1 raises one Error issue per duplicated key: 4 in File A and 6 in File B. Commit is blocked until resolved.

seeded_defects.title: Equipment whose attribute differs from the value on its functional location
seeded_defects.expected: C5 keeps the equipment value and records both values in an INFO issue.

seeded_defects.title: Equipment carrying an object type that no default map knows
seeded_defects.expected: The mapping screen lists these 12 object types as unmapped. Commit is allowed; the assets load as UNCLASSIFIED and lower the D5 pass rate.

seeded_defects.title: Building subtree that a tenant would exclude
seeded_defects.expected: With TZ1-BLD added to the C1 exclusion list, C1 excludes these 28 functional locations and the 36 equipment installed below them. With the default empty list nothing is excluded.

seeded_defects.title: Functional locations with no equipment on themselves or any descendant
seeded_defects.expected: C4 excludes exactly these rows; every ancestor that still has equipment below it is kept.

seeded_defects.title: Functional location codes that break the declared structure mask
seeded_defects.expected: D9 flags exactly these codes: the last segment starts with digits instead of letters.

seeded_defects.title: Descriptions of three characters or fewer
seeded_defects.expected: D4 fails for exactly these rows: 18 equipment and 6 functional locations.

seeded_defects.title: Equipment sharing a sort field with another equipment
seeded_defects.expected: D6 fails for exactly these 8 equipment: 4 tags, each used by two different equipment numbers.

seeded_defects.title: Equipment with a blank sort field
seeded_defects.expected: C8 falls back to the equipment number as asset_tag for exactly these rows.

seeded_defects.title: Equipment with a system status the default status map does not cover
seeded_defects.expected: C6 maps these to operational status Unknown (status AVLB is not in the default map), and D8 fails for them.

seeded_defects.title: Equipment with no manufacturer and no model
seeded_defects.expected: D10 fails for this many distinct equipment numbers. Spread at random, so rows are not listed and this condition may coincide with others.
